summary: Entering the End or the Nether after creating and reentering a debug world crashes the game
description: Regardless of whether you have entered the End or the Nether on your first entry on the debug world, reentering the debug world and using either the Nether or the End portal will crash the game. Nether Crash Report: End Crash Report:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Enter the world and create a debug world.
4. Exit the world and reenter the debug world.
5. Use either the Nether portal or the End portal.
6. Observe that the game crashes upon entering the Nether or the End.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 20w21a, 20w22a, 1.16 Pre-release 1, 1.16 Pre-release 2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When entering the End or the Nether after creating and reentering a debug world, the game crashes. This issue occurs regardless of whether the player has previously entered the End or Nether in that specific debug world. Upon reentering the debug world and attempting to use either the Nether portal or the End portal, the game consistently crashes. The crash reports generated for both the Nether and the End provide further details on the nature of the crashes, which are critical for diagnosing the issue. Players experiencing this bug should ensure they provide relevant crash reports and any additional context that may assist developers in resolving the problem.
Expected Behavior: When reentering a debug world after its creation, players should be able to successfully use Nether and End portals without any crashes occurring. Upon entering either dimension, the game should load normally, allowing players to explore and interact with the environment as intended. This behavior should remain consistent across multiple entries into the debug world, ensuring a stable gaming experience without unexpected terminations.
